description: Apex OS vertical-slice architecture dependency boundaries. Consumed by scripts/architecture/validate-boundaries.mjs. Phase 0: enforcement covers only the new architecture roots; frontend/, backend/ and e2e/ are legacy-active and enter enforcement as their modules migrate.

legacyActiveRoots.reason: These are the live application roots serving production. They are excluded from enforcement until their modules migrate, per Phase 0 scope.

apps.notes: Composition shells only. No business rules. One app must not import another app's internals.

platforms.notes: Cross-component and cross-platform imports must use a public index entry point.

shared.notes: Cross-cutting only. Importing a platform inverts the dependency graph.

database.notes: Bottom of the graph. Schema, migrations and the Prisma client import nothing internal.

rules.description: Frontend code must not import backend code.
rules.rationale: Server code must never reach the browser bundle.

rules.description: Backend code must not import frontend code.
rules.rationale: Server runtime must not depend on browser modules.

rules.description: shared/ must not import apps/ or platforms/.
rules.rationale: shared/ is depended upon by platforms; importing back creates a cycle.

rules.description: database/ must not import apps/, platforms/ or shared/.
rules.rationale: The Prisma client must be importable from every layer without a cycle.
Apps compose platforms, never the reverse.

rules.description: An app must not import another app's internal files.
Cross-component imports must target a component's public entry point, not its internal frontend/, backend/, shared/ or tests/ folders.
rules.rationale: A component's internals are private; only index.ts is public.

publicEntryPoints.notes: A cross-component import may address the component directory itself or its index file, but must not address a path inside it.
